dek: Radio Television Hong Kong (RTHK) held the Solar Project 2026 Closing Ceremony today (August 13). The Permanent Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development, Ms Angela Lee, officiated as guest of honour, joining the Director of Broadcasting, Ms Angelina Kwan, to witness 106 students from 77 secondary schools present
